development_source.candidate_frames: reuse exact training-only candidate_pool_pre_outcome.csv; no regeneration

router.target: fold-level frozen Rescue-v2 10-km held-out recovery minus frozen-v1 10-km held-out recovery
router.training_weight: each taxon-region pair has equal total weight across its complete spatial folds
router.decision_rule: choose frozen Rescue-v2 only when predicted Rescue-v2 minus frozen-v1 fold recall is >= 0.015; otherwise choose frozen-v1
router.tie_rule: threshold comparison is deterministic; no outcome-dependent fallback

development_evaluation.unit: taxon-region pair after averaging five frozen spatial folds
development_evaluation.primary_gate: mean router minus frozen-v1 >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% lower >0 AND sign-flip p<0.05
development_evaluation.group_guardrail: plant and animal means each >=0.015, bootstrap 95% lower >0, and sign-flip p<0.05
development_evaluation.interpretation: development evidence only because model family/features/threshold were selected after inspection of these 192 reclassified development pairs

future_confirmation.balanced_factorial: 12 region cells x plant/animal x four record-count strata x two taxa
future_confirmation.excluded_taxa_union: old invalidated 192 + original Rescue72 development + inspected fresh-v2 192 = 456 unique taxa if disjoint; verify exact union before sampling
must_pass: router minus corrected official GRTS v2 >=0.015 with CI lower>0 and p<0.05
router minus frozen-v1 >=0.015 with CI lower>0 and p<0.05
future_confirmation.group_guardrail: plant and animal primary directions must remain positive; predeclare exact group gate before sampling

claim_boundary: vNext2 is development-only until a new untouched cohort passes; prospective field-effort/access gate and native biosurvey end-to-end gate remain separate.
